unresolved_uncertainty.what: Every row in this cluster sits inside the dateline block opened at MT 40:1, and none of the seven names that block; the row schema carries no field for it.
unresolved_uncertainty.why_it_matters: The corpus requires each unit to disclose its dated block, so either the disclosure is missing across the whole cluster or the requirement was changed. This lane cannot tell which from what it reads, so it is recorded once as a uniform question rather than as seven separate findings.

unresolved_uncertainty.what: Whether the seam inside MT 41:12-41:26 belongs at 41:16 or at 41:15 turns on how the closing clause of 41:15 is weighed, since it names the structures the following description then takes up.
unresolved_uncertainty.why_it_matters: This lane places 41:15 with the measured accounting because the measure verb and the hundred-cubit figure are both in that verse, but a reading that treats the naming clause as the head of the description would put the seam one verse earlier. The two-movement finding is the same either way; only the exact verse moves.
